eventTemplate.title: [Camunda Infrastructure] ElasticHighNumberOfShards
eventTemplate.description:
Elasticsearch shard usage > 90% of cluster capacity in namespace {dims} for 10 minutes — risk of shard allocation failures.

Metric names use the underscored Prometheus spelling (elasticsearch_cluster_health_active_shards, not dots): Elasticsearch is not a Micrometer app, so its elasticsearch_exporter endpoint reaches Dynatrace (if at all) through an OTel Collector's prometheus receiver, which keeps the Prometheus spelling verbatim (see dynatrace/runbook-dynatrace.md step 1). This differs from datadog_alerts/, which dotted this same metric because Datadog's OpenMetrics check always converts names that way.
